# Elation Health

> Elation Health is an AI-native EHR platform purpose-built for primary care practices, offering integrated clinical documentation, medical billing, practice management, and patient engagement tools.

Elation Health provides a comprehensive suite of healthcare software solutions designed to streamline primary care operations, from clinical workflows to revenue cycle management. The platform emphasizes AI-powered automation, HIPAA compliance, and seamless health information exchange through HL7/FHIR integrations.

## Core EHR Platform

- [Electronic Health Record (EHR) Software](https://www.elationhealth.com/solutions/ehr): Core EHR software with AI-powered clinical documentation and eprescribing
- [All-in-One EHR](https://www.elationhealth.com/solutions/unified-ehr): Unified EHR platform streamlining workflows and practice operations
- [AI-Powered Medical Scribe | Note Assist](https://www.elationhealth.com/solutions/ehr/note-assist): AI medical scribe automating clinical note generation for primary care
- [Streamline Care with Elation's EHR Mobile App](https://www.elationhealth.com/solutions/ehr/elation-go): Mobile EHR app enabling document scanning, prescriptions, and telehealth access

## Billing & Revenue Management

- [Elation Billing: Medical Billing Software](https://www.elationhealth.com/solutions/elation-billing): AI-powered medical billing platform integrated with Elation EHR
- [Medical Billing Software to Reduce Administrative Work](https://www.elationhealth.com/practice-success/billing): Integrated billing solution reducing administrative burden and improving payments
- [How to Save Money Processing Patient Payments](https://www.elationhealth.com/practice-success/billing/patient-payments): Guide on cost-effective patient payment processing with Elation platform
- [Elation Announces Collaborative Billing](https://www.elationhealth.com/resources/unified-billing/elation-announces-collaborative-billing): Announcement of Collaborative Billing feature enabling incident-to billing
- [Capitation in Medical Billing: A Guide for Primary Care Clinicians](https://www.elationhealth.com/resources/blogs/capitation-billing): Educational guide on capitation payment models for primary care providers

## Practice Management & Operations

- [Practice Management System](https://www.elationhealth.com/solutions/practice-management-system): Integrated practice management system for scheduling, billing, and admin tasks
- [Primary Care Clinic Software Solutions](https://www.elationhealth.com/solutions): Complete suite of EHR, billing, and practice management solutions for modern clinics
- [Primary Care Practice Efficiency & Success](https://www.elationhealth.com/practice-success): Practice success hub showcasing efficiency tools and revenue optimization

## Patient Engagement & Care Delivery

- [Patient Passport](https://www.elationhealth.com/solutions/ehr/patient-passport): Patient portal providing secure medical record access and doctor communication
- [Best Telehealth Software for Primary Care Practices](https://www.elationhealth.com/solutions/ehr/telehealth): HIPAA-compliant telehealth platform integrated with Elation EHR
- [Patient Engagement Tools](https://www.elationhealth.com/practice-success/patient-engagement): Patient engagement tools including portals and communication for care delivery
